model.note: Part outlines are traced from John Deere's studio photo of a Z997R with the 72 in. 7-Iron PRO deck and are approximate. The engine, filters, fuel system, hydraulics, cooling, battery, blades, deck belt and gearbox are hidden and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from JD Replacement Parts Guide TC527978-80 (Apr 2022), the Z997R Keep Green parts pages and OM omuc22368 (export). Confirm the deck size (60 or 72 in.), Tier 4 or non-Tier 4 engine and the real PIN on the plates before ordering.

rops.name: ROPS and seat belt
rops.desc: Keep the ROPS up and pinned and check the seat belt daily. Check the torque on the ROPS hardware every 500 h or yearly.

seat.name: Operator seat
seat.desc: The seat switch is one of the safety interlocks with the PTO, park brake and neutral start: check them and the park brake daily.

leverL.name: Motion control lever, left
leverL.desc: The two motion control levers drive and steer the machine. As needed (OEM): check and adjust transmission neutral, align the motion control levers and adjust tracking.

leverR.name: Motion control lever, right
leverR.desc: The two motion control levers drive and steer the machine. As needed (OEM): check and adjust transmission neutral, align the motion control levers and adjust tracking.

console.name: Left control console
console.desc: Operator controls on the left of the seat. The machine keeps service timers on its display: reset them after every oil change or the service warnings will be wrong (set 250 h engine oil and 500 h hydraulic oil after the 50 h break-in).

hood.name: Rear hood (engine bay)
hood.desc: Daily: engine oil, hydraulic oil and coolant levels, leaks, air restriction indicator (daily in dust or heat), dust unloading valve and clean hood sealing surfaces. After use clean the machine and the cooling system.

body.name: Rear fender and side panel
body.desc: Check for loose or damaged parts, belts and guards daily (OEM daily checks).

tyreR.name: Rear drive tyre
tyreR.desc: 26 x 12-12 at 96.5-110 kPa (14-16 psi): check daily. Tyre UC21446. Check and tighten the wheel hardware at the 5 h break-in and every 50 h or yearly.

casterL.name: Front caster wheel, left
casterL.desc: 15 x 6-6 semi-pneumatic caster wheel TCA21693. Emmetts names this number "rim and wheel centre": confirm it is the complete wheel before ordering. Grease the caster wheels and caster spindles every 50 h or yearly; check caster spindle torque at the 5 h break-in.

casterR.name: Front caster wheel, right
casterR.desc: 15 x 6-6 semi-pneumatic caster wheel TCA21693. Emmetts names this number "rim and wheel centre": confirm it is the complete wheel before ordering. Grease the caster wheels and caster spindles every 50 h or yearly; check caster spindle torque at the 5 h break-in.

frame.name: Front frame (Max-Frame), footrest and deck lift
frame.desc: Grease the mower lift components and drive shafts every 50 h or yearly, and after washing. Grease: JD Multi-Purpose SD Polyurea or HD Lithium Complex (NLGI 2). Check and tighten wheel hardware at the same service.

deck.name: Mower deck, 7-Iron PRO
deck.desc: The photo shows the 72 in. deck. Deck size is not recorded for Z-trac 1: blade TCU15882 on the club list implies 72 in. Confirm before ordering blades and belts. After use: check the deck belts and blades and clean under the deck. Every 50 h or yearly: grease the 3 spindles and the deck idler arm pivot and check the deck. Deck gearbox oil 0.325 L GL-5 every 500 h or yearly. Check the blades after every use. Sharpen keeping the original bevel, cutting edge no more than 0.40 mm, balance before fitting, wing toward the deck top and concave washer toward the blade, bolt torque 122 N.m. Never straighten or weld a bent or cracked blade: replace it.

gauge.name: Deck gauge wheel and roller
gauge.desc: From the Z997R parts guides: gauge wheel TCU18744, roller TCU34060, deck extension spring M136044 (72 in.) or TCU16582 (60 in.).

blades.name: Mower blades (3 per deck)
blades.desc: 72 in. deck: high lift TCU15882 (club standard), low lift M141669, mulch M142514. 60 in. deck: high lift TCU15881, low lift M133381, mulch M168223, mulch-on-demand TCU18990, standard M128485. Check the blades after every use. Sharpen keeping the original bevel, cutting edge no more than 0.40 mm, balance before fitting, wing toward the deck top and concave washer toward the blade, bolt torque 122 N.m. Never straighten or weld a bent or cracked blade: replace it.

deckbelt.name: Deck drive belt
deckbelt.desc: 72 in. side discharge deck: TCU19900. 60 in. side discharge: DMU210282. Check after each use (OEM); set the tension by the OM procedure.

gearbox.name: Deck gearbox
gearbox.desc: Change the oil every 500 h or yearly: 0.325 L GL-5 gear oil.

engine.name: Engine: Yanmar 3TNV88C diesel
engine.desc: 3-cylinder, 1.642 L, liquid cooled, direct injection, glow plugs (export OM). Fast idle 3030 +/- 20 rpm, slow idle 1525 +/- 20 rpm. Oil 5.2 L with filter, JD Plus-50 II or Torq-Gard Supreme: oil and filter M806419 every 250 h or yearly, then reset the engine oil timer. Valve clearance 0.15-0.25 mm at 1000 h; fuel injectors at 1500 h. The export OM has DPF regeneration pages: if this unit has a DPF, follow the regen procedures and use low-ash oil (Plus-50 II). At about 965 h (Oct 2026) the 1,000 h service is close: oil, fuel filter, hydraulic oil and filter, gearbox oil, ROPS torque and valve clearance. Read the PIN and engine plates: the recorded serial CH3Y17D089272 is not a JD PIN.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Change with the oil every 250 h or yearly (5.2 L JD Plus-50 II).

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Primary element M131802 every 300 h, secondary M131803 every 500 h (parts guide). After fitting a new primary, run at high idle: if the indicator turns red, change the secondary too. Never wash or blow out the elements.

fuel.name: Fuel tank, water separator and in-line filter
fuel.desc: Diesel tank 43.5 L. Daily: drain the separator bowl if the red float ring has lifted. In-line fuel filter every 500 h or yearly, arrow in the direction of flow, change it when the tank is low: MIU800645 for the non-Tier 4 engine or MIU803127 for the Tier 4: check which is fitted. Separator element MIU802421 fits the Z997R on the JD shop but is not in either Z997R parts guide: replace it when the bowl shows water or dirt and match the element in the bowl before ordering.

hydraulics.name: Hydraulic reservoir and filter
hydraulics.desc: 22.8 L JD Hy-Gard J20C. Filter M146082 and oil at the 50 h break-in, then every 500 h or yearly: drain at the filter and the pump drain plug, then reset the hydraulic timer. Check the level daily.

drive.name: Traction drive units
drive.desc: Grease for the traction unit: JD non-clay high-temperature #2. As needed: check and adjust transmission neutral and tracking.

cooling.name: Radiator, coolant and thermostat
cooling.desc: 7.1 L ethylene-glycol coolant (JD Cool-Gard II). Check the level daily. Check the freeze point and clarity at 1500 h; change coolant and thermostat at 2000 h (drain, flush, fill, bleed). Replace radiator hoses as needed.

belt.name: Engine fan belt
belt.desc: Deflection 10-15 mm. The parts guide lists TCU34832 as the fan belt for the Tier 4 engine and no non-Tier 4 belt: confirm on the machine.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: 12 V, 600 CCA, reserve capacity 85 min, BCI group 47 (export OM). The parts guide lists MCYP25876 (not for US/Canada): buy to the OM spec. Clean the terminals every 50 h or yearly.

spindle.name: Deck spindle and pulley (3 per deck)
spindle.desc: Cast iron spindle assembly TCA25356 from deck S/N 020001 (TCA24881 up to 020000). Grease the spindles every 50 h or yearly.

MIU803127.name: In-line fuel filter, Tier 4 engine
MIU803127.note: Only on the Tier 4 engine. Emmetts $71.80 ex GST (club paid $71.07).

TCU15881.note: Only if the deck is 60 in.
